title: Cleft Sentences
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado las Cleft Sentences. Ahora puedes dirigir la atención de tus oyentes exactamente hacia donde tú quieres en una negociación o presentación.

parts.visual:
Usamos Cleft Sentences para enfatizar una parte específica de la oración. 
Normal: The CEO fired John yesterday. 
Énfasis en la persona (It was... who/that): 
Ej: IT WAS the CEO WHO fired John yesterday. (Fue el CEO quien despidió a John).
parts.audio: We use Cleft Sentences to emphasize a specific part of a sentence. Normal sentence: The CEO fired John yesterday. To emphasize the person, use 'It was', plus the person, plus 'who' or 'that'. For example: It was the CEO who fired John yesterday.

parts.visual:
Énfasis en la acción o la cosa (What... is/was): 
Normal: We need more time. 
Ej: WHAT we need IS more time. (Lo que necesitamos es más tiempo). 
Normal: I hated his attitude. 
Ej: WHAT I hated WAS his attitude. (Lo que odié fue su actitud).
parts.audio: To emphasize the action or the thing, use 'What', plus the subject and verb, plus 'is' or 'was'. Normal sentence: We need more time. Emphasized: What we need is more time. Normal sentence: I hated his attitude. Emphasized: What I hated was his attitude.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de completar la oración enfática.

questions.question:
Normal: Sarah found the error. 
Enfática: ____ was Sarah who found the error.

Normal: I want a refund. 
Enfática: ____ I want is a refund.
____ is the lack of communication that worries me. (Lo que me preocupa es / ES la falta...).
questions.explanation: It is [la falta de comunicación] that...

questions.question: ____ we really need right now is a new marketing strategy.
It was in Paris ____ they signed the contract. (Enfocando el lugar).
questions.explanation: También se acepta 'that', pero 'where' es común para lugares (It was in Paris where...). Aquí la opción que contrasta con that puede generar duda, pero ambas son aceptables. Usualmente enseñamos: It was [lugar] that/where.

questions.question: ____ happened was that the server crashed completely.
It wasn't me ____ made the mistake, it was John! (El que).
____ the boss wants is better results. (Lo que).
It was the marketing budget ____ they decided to cut.
____ I admire most about her is her leadership style.
It is money ____ drives this industry.
____ they did was totally unacceptable.
It was only yesterday ____ I found out about the merger.
____ we have to do now is wait for their response.
questions.explanation: What we have to do is...

questions.question: It was because of the rain ____ the flight was delayed.
____ surprised me the most was his calm reaction.
No, it ____ Steve who lost the file. It was Mark.
____ you need is a long vacation.
questions.explanation: What you need is... (También se usa 'All you need is...', pero 'All what' es incorrecto).

questions.question: It was the CFO ____ discovered the fraud.
____ I am trying to say is that we need a new plan.
questions.explanation: What I'm trying to say is...

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'It' o 'What' para completar la cleft sentence.

questions.question: ____ was the CEO who fired him. (Fue)
____ we need is more money. (Lo que)
____ was yesterday that he called. (Fue)
____ I want is a refund. (Lo que)
____ is the system that failed. (Es)
____ happened was a disaster. (Lo que)
____ was Sarah who solved it. (Fue)
____ surprised me was his attitude. (Lo que)
____ was in Paris where we met. (Fue)
____ they did is illegal. (Lo que)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración enfática correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was the CEO who fired him.
options: It was the CEO who fired him.
It was the CEO that fired him.
What the CEO did was fire him.
questions.correct_answer: It was the CEO who fired him.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What we need is more time.
options: What we need is more time.
It is more time that we need.
What we needed was more time.
questions.correct_answer: What we need is more time.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was yesterday that she called.
options: It was yesterday that she called.
What happened yesterday was she called.
It was yesterday when she called.
questions.correct_answer: It was yesterday that she called.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: It was a disaster that happened.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It wasn't me who made the mistake.
options: It wasn't me who made the mistake.
It isn't me who makes the mistake.
What I didn't do was make the mistake.
questions.correct_answer: It wasn't me who made the mistake.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What I want is a refund.
options: What I want is a refund.
It is a refund that I want.
What I wanted was a refund.
questions.correct_answer: What I want is a refund.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is money that drives this industry.
options: It is money that drives this industry.
What drives this industry is money.
It was money that drove this industry.
questions.correct_answer: It is money that drives this industry.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What surprised me was his attitude.
options: What surprised me was his attitude.
It was his attitude that surprised me.
What surprises me is his attitude.
questions.correct_answer: What surprised me was his attitude.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was Sarah who solved the problem.
options: It was Sarah who solved the problem.
What Sarah did was solve the problem.
It is Sarah who solves the problem.
questions.correct_answer: It was Sarah who solved the problem.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: It is illegal what they did.
